summary: Master Voice of Customer and Customer Insight Analytics with NPS, CSAT, Excel, and Power BI to turn feedback into action.
lede: Voice of Customer analytics helps customer experience, insight, and service professionals turn feedback into practical improvement priorities. The course covers designing feedback capture and preparing data, analyzing responses and comments through segmentation and theme coding, and reporting findings with Excel and Power BI dashboards, journey analysis, and action plans with clear ownership and follow-up.
audienceIntro: This course is for you if you work with customer feedback, survey data, service interactions, or customer experience reporting and need a practical VoC method you can use immediately. It suits professionals who must turn customer comments, scores, and journey signals into clear actions for service, product, marketing, or account teams.
prerequisites: You should have a basic understanding of customer service, customer experience, CRM reports, or market research processes. A laptop with Excel and access to Power BI Desktop is recommended for the hands-on exercises; datasets can be provided if you do not bring internal files.
